edge_sample.source_text: definition : Define the union of all finite sets indexed by \verb|β|, where each set is given by a function \verb|A : β → Finset α|.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma : Prove that the union of all finite sets indexed by \verb|β| is equal to the union of their corresponding sets in \verb|Set α|.

edge_sample.source_text: lemma : The value of the negation of a proposition P is equal to 1 minus the value of P.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma : The characteristic function of the union of two finite sets \verb|A| and \verb|B| is equal to 1 minus the product of 1 minus their characteristic functions.

edge_sample.source_text: definition : Assign a value to a proposition. If the proposition holds, assign a value of 1; otherwise, assign a value of 0.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma : The value of the negation of a proposition P is equal to 1 minus the value of P.

edge_sample.source_text: definition : Define the union of a multiset of finite sets indexed by \verb|β|, where each set is given by a function \verb|A : β → Finset α|.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma : Prove that an element is in the union of a multiset of finite sets if and only if it is in at least one of the sets.

edge_sample.source_text: definition : Define the intersection of a multiset of finite sets indexed by \verb|β|, where each set is given by a function \verb|A : β → Finset α|.
edge_sample.target_text: definition : Define the intersection of all finite sets indexed by \verb|β|, where each set is given by a function \verb|A : β → Finset α|.

edge_sample.source_text: lemma : If a finite set \verb|A| is equal to a set \verb|B| in the sense of set theory, then they have the same number of elements.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma : The cardinality of a subset \verb|B| of \verb|A| is equal to the sum of the characteristic function of \verb|B| over \verb|A|.

edge_sample.source_text: definition : Assign a value to a proposition. If the proposition holds, assign a value of 1; otherwise, assign a value of 0.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma : The characteristic function of the intersection of two finite sets \verb|A| and \verb|B| is equal to the product of their characteristic functions.

edge_sample.source_text: definition : Define the union of all finite sets indexed by \verb|β|, where each set is given by a function \verb|A : β → Finset α|.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma : The cardinality of the union of a family of finite sets indexed by \verb|β| is equal to the cardinality of their union in \verb|Finset| form.

edge_sample.source_text: lemma : Prove that the union of all finite sets indexed by \verb|β| is equal to the union of their corresponding sets in \verb|Set α|.
edge_sample.target_text: lemma : The characteristic function of the union of a family of finite sets indexed by \verb|β| is equal to 1 minus the product of 1 minus their characteristic functions.

edge_sample.source_text: lemma : Formalize the polynomial expansion of \(1 - \prod_{i=0}^{n-1} (1 - g(i))\) in the context of finite sets of natural numbers up to \verb|n|.
